note: Long-only first pass. weight 1.0 is 100% of equity in index notional, about 0.4 MNQ per $25,000 at NQ 31,000; one MNQ is 2.5x.

strategies.name: VWAP reclaim, morning
strategies.thesis: NQ stretched 0.4% under the day's VWAP in the first 2.5 hours, RSI washed out, first up bar: buy the snap back to VWAP.

entry_rules.when: is_rth == 1 and minutes_since_open >= 15 and minutes_since_open <= 150 and dist_session_vwap < -0.004 and rsi7 < 30 and ret1 > 0

strategies.name: Opening-range breakout
strategies.thesis: Buy the first close just above the 60-minute opening range high; out when price falls back inside the range.

entry_rules.when: is_rth == 1 and or_broken_up == 1 and dist_or_high > 0 and dist_or_high < 0.0025 and minutes_since_open < 180 and ret1 > 0

strategies.name: Failed breakdown of the opening range
strategies.thesis: Price broke below the opening-range low and reclaimed it: the sellers failed, target VWAP.

entry_rules.when: is_rth == 1 and or_broken_down == 1 and dist_or_low > 0 and prev(dist_or_low) < 0 and minutes_since_open < 240

strategies.name: Pullback to VWAP on an up day
strategies.thesis: A rising 20-bar mean and a dip to the day's VWAP: buy the pullback, hold an hour.

entry_rules.when: is_rth == 1 and minutes_since_open >= 60 and minutes_since_open <= 300 and dist_session_vwap > -0.0005 and dist_session_vwap < 0.0015 and ret5 < -0.002 and rsi7 < 40 and sma20_slope > 0

strategies.name: First-hour capitulation
strategies.thesis: A 0.6% flush in the opening hour with RSI under 25 that closes in the top half of its bar: the intraday version of Capitulation Close.

entry_rules.when: is_first_hour == 1 and minutes_since_open >= 10 and ret5 < -0.006 and rsi7 < 25 and (close - low) / (high - low + 0.25) > 0.5

strategies.name: Power-hour dip
strategies.thesis: Under VWAP and washed out after 15:00: buy the last-hour bounce, flat before the close.

entry_rules.when: is_power_hour == 1 and minute_of_day <= 935 and dist_session_vwap < -0.003 and rsi7 < 30 and ret1 > 0

strategies.name: Midday 2-sigma dip in an uptrend
strategies.thesis: Above the 50-bar mean, two standard deviations under the 20-bar mean, first up bar: buy the dip, out at the mean.

entry_rules.when: is_rth == 1 and minutes_since_open >= 120 and minutes_since_open <= 330 and dist_sma50 > 0 and zscore20 < -2.0 and ret1 > 0

strategies.name: Breakout pullback
strategies.thesis: Above the opening range and VWAP, a small pullback that turns up: trend continuation, out on a close under VWAP.

entry_rules.when: is_rth == 1 and or_broken_up == 1 and dist_or_high > 0.001 and dist_session_vwap > 0.001 and ret5 < -0.0015 and ret1 > 0 and minutes_since_open < 300
